scope: Checked compiler box/read hooks and private versioned recursive runtime ABI; source and recursive transport admission remain closed

implementation.emitter: MLIR LLVM-dialect box/read operations with bounded iterative dependency enumeration, cached variant slots, entry-block temporary slots and distinct nominal address tokens
implementation.ownership: Only active recursive references are retained; inline numeric records are traversed; unsupported owned fields fail explicitly
implementation.runtime_bridge: Request validation, invocation-owned pointer lookup, duplicate/null table handling, rollback on failure and typed reads
implementation.backend_hooks: Record construction, field reads, immediate validation and managed-backing cleanup recognition
implementation.checked_abi: Versioned make/read calls carry the invocation and poll before subsequent memory access

coverage: MLIR verification, LLVM translation and checked ABI verification
Compiled constructors and reads with shared recursive child references
Inactive enum fields with invalid pointer bits do not become retained dependencies
Allocation failure at each generated publication with balanced checked call slots
Wrong nominal token with matching physical size and aligned unknown pointers fail before loads
Foreign/unknown dependency rejection and rollback after partial acquisition
Invalid dependency tables and projection metadata
Unsupported owned String field and incorrect physical operand rejection
Prior runtime deep/shared lifetime tests and preserved source/backend recursion gates
Existing compiled numeric/managed enum payloads and worker regressions
qualification.environment_note: One regression invocation selected the retired system linker. Re-running with Command Line Tools first in PATH passed; no dependency changes were required.
qualification.format: New C++ files pass clang-format --dry-run --Werror; git diff --check passes

limitations: Compiler-component tests construct checked physical IR directly; recursive .k programs are still rejected
Initial emitter supports numeric/Bool leaves, inline numeric records and managed recursive references; wider owned payloads are rejected
Control-flow/matching, immutable source updates and synchronous source admission still need qualification
Recursive worker transport, GPU and public C/C++ ABI remain outside this change
